name: Yuna Baek
education: Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering from Pusan National University
bio: Yuna spends most of her weekdays inspecting coastal facilities along the southern Korean coastline and drafting regulatory reports that few people ever read. On weekends she volunteers at a local ceramics cooperative where she is slowly learning to throw bowls on a kick wheel. She keeps a meticulous spreadsheet of every board game she has played since 2019 and quietly competes with herself to try a new one each month. Her apartment is filled with potted herbs she grows under LED panels and she insists on making her own gochujang from scratch every autumn. Friends describe her as the person who always remembers birthdays but rarely posts on social media herself.
